evals.prompt: Create a skill for converting messy clinic CSV exports into a cleaned Excel workbook with one summary sheet and one validation sheet.
evals.expected_output: A lean skill with scripts for deterministic CSV/XLSX handling, realistic evals, validation guidance, and packaging steps.

assertions.text: The draft separates deterministic transformation code into scripts rather than prose-only instructions.
The draft includes at least two realistic eval prompts or an evals.json scaffold.
The SKILL.md frontmatter description includes trigger contexts, not only a title.

evals.prompt: We have done the same vendor onboarding review three times: summarize intake notes, check missing risk fields, draft follow-up questions, and produce a short decision memo. I did not ask you to create a skill yet, but this keeps coming up.
evals.expected_output: A brief skill proposal, not file changes, with the job, trigger, output, likely resources, and why the workflow is worth capturing, plus a request for confirmation before scaffolding.

assertions.text: The response proposes a new skill brief instead of creating files.
The brief names the job, trigger, output, likely resources, and reason to capture the workflow.
The response asks for confirmation before scaffolding the skill.
